```{r}
fix_panel_size <- function(p, panel_width = 3, panel_height = 3, unit = "cm") {
  gt <- ggplotGrob(p)
  pp <- gt$layout[gt$layout$name == "panel", ]

  gt$widths[pp$l]  <- grid::unit(panel_width, unit)
  gt$heights[pp$t] <- grid::unit(panel_height, unit)

  gt
```

# Data laoding and processing


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: true
## m6A
path_f <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Miona/Nanopore/PlaB_mRNA_all/filtered_m6A_cov_5/"
all_f <- list.files(path_f)

for (i in 1:length(all_f)) {
    if (i == 1) {
        all_sites <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        all_sites$sample <- sub("HEK293T_mRNA_", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("_filtered_m6A.bed", "", .)
    } else {
        tmp <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        tmp$sample <- sub("HEK293T_mRNA_", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("_filtered_m6A.bed", "", .)
        all_sites <- rbind(all_sites, tmp)
    }
}

all_sites <- all_sites %>% mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB1_")        ~ "STM.PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB10_")       ~ "STM.PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB100_")      ~ "STM.PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB100_")          ~ "PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB10_")           ~ "PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB1_")            ~ "PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      str_detect(sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )
)

all_sites$rep <- sub(".*_", "", all_sites$sample) 

all_sites$m6A <- all_sites$Stoichiometry > 20
m6A_all <- all_sites[all_sites$m6A == T,] 

## m6A presented in at least two reps as detected m6A sites
m6A_all$ID_2 <- paste0(m6A_all$ID, "_", m6A_all$condition)

n_id <- table(m6A_all$ID_2) %>% as.data.frame(.)
n_id$condition <- sub(".*_", "", n_id$Var1)
n_id$ID <- sub("_.*", "", n_id$Var1)
## keep ID in more than two replicates
n_id_f <- n_id[n_id$Freq == 2,]

## function to make m6A GRange object from ID
make_m6A_gr_mRNA <- function(ID, info){
    ## make coordinate df
    df <- data.frame(seqnames = sub(":.*", "", ID$ID),
                     start = getstr(ID$ID, ":", 1, " ", 1),
                     end = getstr(ID$ID, ":", 1, " ", 1),
                     strand = sub(".* ", "", ID$ID),
                     ID = ID$ID,
                     condition = ID$condition)
    test_rep <- c("Rep1", "Rep2")
    unique_condition <- unique(ID$condition)
    ## assign information
    for (i in 1:length(unique_condition)) {
    used_info <- info[info$condition == unique_condition[[i]],]
    
    ## loop through all reps

    
    for (i in seq_len(length(test_rep))) {
        tmp_info <- used_info[used_info$rep == test_rep[[i]],]
        ## new column names
        name1 <- paste0(unique(tmp_info$condition), "_", unique(tmp_info$rep), "_", "N_cov")
        name2 <- paste0(unique(tmp_info$condition), "_", unique(tmp_info$rep), "_", "stoi")
        
        ## assign value
        df[[name1]] <- tmp_info$N_valid_cov[match(
            df$ID, tmp_info$ID
        )]
        df[[name2]] <- tmp_info$Stoichiometry[match(
            df$ID, tmp_info$ID
        )]
    }
    }
    out <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(df, keep.extra.columns = T)
    return(out)
}

## make m6A 
m6A_all <- make_m6A_gr_mRNA(n_id_f, all_sites)

## calculate mean
m6A_all <- as.data.frame(m6A_all) %>%
  mutate(
    DMSO_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^DMSO_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    DMSO_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^DMSO_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    PlaB.1nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.1nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PlaB.1nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.1nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PlaB.10nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.10nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PlaB.10nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.10nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    PlaB.100nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.100nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PlaB.100nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^PlaB.100nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    STM.PlaB.1nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.1nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    STM.PlaB.1nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.1nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    STM.PlaB.10nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.10nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    STM.PlaB.10nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.10nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    STM.PlaB.100nM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.100nM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    STM.PlaB.100nM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM.PlaB.100nM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),

    STM_mean_cov = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM_Rep[0-9]+_N_cov$")), na.rm = TRUE),
    STM_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^STM_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      ends_with(c("_mean_cov", "_mean_stoi")),
      ~ replace(.x, is.nan(.x), NA_real_)
    )
  )

m6A_all <- m6A_all[order(m6A_all$condition),]
m6A_all <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(m6A_all, keep.extra.columns = T)

m6A_all$Stoichiometry <- 
    case_when(m6A_all$condition == "DMSO" ~ m6A_all$DMSO_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "STM" ~ m6A_all$STM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "PlaB.1nM" ~ m6A_all$PlaB.1nM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "PlaB.10nM" ~ m6A_all$PlaB.10nM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "PlaB.100nM" ~ m6A_all$PlaB.100nM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "STM.PlaB.1nM" ~ m6A_all$STM.PlaB.1nM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "STM.PlaB.10nM" ~ m6A_all$STM.PlaB.10nM_mean_stoi,
             m6A_all$condition == "STM.PlaB.100nM" ~ m6A_all$STM.PlaB.100nM_mean_stoi)
m6A_all_mRNA <- m6A_all[seqnames(m6A_all) %in% standardChromosomes(m6A_all)]
m6A_all_mRNA$condition_RNA <- paste0(m6A_all_mRNA$condition, "_mRNA")
saveRDS(m6A_all_mRNA, "rds/m6A_mRNA_nanopore.rds")
```

# IRratio changes and candidate IR table generation

```{r}
IRratio_mRNA <- readRDS("rds/IRratio_all_introns_mRNA_nanopore.rds")
IRratio_mRNA$Sample <- sub("HEK293T_mRNA_", "", IRratio_mRNA$Sample) %>%
    sub(".sorted.1nt.bw", "", .)

IRratio_mRNA$rep <- sub(".*_", "", IRratio_mRNA$Sample)
IRratio_mRNA <- IRratio_mRNA %>% mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "STM_PlaB1_")        ~ "STM.PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "STM_PlaB10_")       ~ "STM.PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "STM_PlaB100_")      ~ "STM.PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "PlaB100_")          ~ "PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "PlaB10_")           ~ "PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "PlaB1_")            ~ "PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(Sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      str_detect(Sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )
)

## make differential IR result
intronDepth <- 1
AveExpr <- 0.2
SSratio <- 1.2
maxExon_expression <- 10
## get IR result
## PlaB STM
ir_PlaB.1nM_STM.PlaB.1nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("PlaB.1nM", "STM.PlaB.1nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "PlaB.1nM_vs_STM.PlaB.1nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)

ir_PlaB.10nM_STM.PlaB.10nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("PlaB.10nM", "STM.PlaB.10nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "PlaB.10nM_vs_STM.PlaB.10nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)

ir_PlaB.100nM_STM.PlaB.100nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("PlaB.100nM", "STM.PlaB.100nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "PlaB.100nM_vs_STM.PlaB.100nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)

## PlaB
ir_DMSO_PlaB.1nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("DMSO", "PlaB.1nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "DMSO_vs_PlaB.1nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)
ir_DMSO_PlaB.10nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("DMSO", "PlaB.10nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "DMSO_vs_PlaB.10nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)
ir_DMSO_PlaB.100nM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("DMSO", "PlaB.100nM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "DMSO_vs_PlaB.100nM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)

## STM
ir_DMSO_STM <- 
    make_IR_comparison(IRratio_mRNA, intronDepth = intronDepth, SSratio = SSratio, 
                       AveExpr = AveExpr, maxExon_expression = maxExon_expression,
                       condition = c("DMSO", "STM"), n_rep = 4) %>%
    mutate(comparison = "DMSO_vs_STM") %>%
    filter(delta_IR_lm <= 1 & delta_IR_lm >= -1)
```

```{r}
             aes(x = delta_IR_lm, color = bin_dPSI_plab)) +
```

# Comparison between mRNA and dFORCE result

## IRratio in mature and nascent RNA for express genes
To identify the intron in expressed gene, here I filter for SS ratio and the coverage at the 
adjacent exons.

## Fig S5A

```{r}
## read and process dFORCE IRratio
IRratio_dFORCE <- readRDS("~/Desktop/Project/Julian_lab/m6A_splicing_deposition_code/06 dFORCE/rds/IRratio_all_introns_dFORCE.rds")

IRratio_dFORCE$Sample <- sub("dForce_", "", IRratio_dFORCE$Sample)
IRratio_dFORCE$Sample <- sub(".sorted.1nt.bw", "", IRratio_dFORCE$Sample)
## prepare data
IRratio_dFORCE <- IRratio_dFORCE %>%
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "PlaB_STM|STM_PlaB") ~ "PlaB.STM",
      str_detect(Sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      str_detect(Sample, "PlaB")              ~ "PlaB",
      str_detect(Sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    rep = sub(".*_", "", Sample),
    replicate = case_when(rep %in% c("2h", "1") ~ "rep1",
                          T ~ rep)
    )
IRratio_dFORCE$rep <- NULL

IRratio_dFORCE_sum <- IRratio_dFORCE %>%
    group_by(Intron_ID, condition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_IRratio = mean(IRratio, na.rm = T),
              mean_IntronDepth = mean(IntronDepth, na.rm = T),
              mean_maxExon_expression = mean(maxExon_expression, na.rm = T),
              mean_SSratio_L = mean(SSratio_L, na.rm = T),
              mean_SSratio_R = mean(SSratio_R, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")

SSratio <- 1.2
maxExon_expression <- 10

IRratio_dFORCE_sum_f <- IRratio_dFORCE_sum %>%
    filter(mean_IRratio <= 1, 
           mean_SSratio_L > SSratio | mean_SSratio_R > SSratio,
           mean_maxExon_expression >= maxExon_expression)  %>%
    mutate(experiment = "dFORCE")

## mRNA data
IRratio_mRNA_sum <- IRratio_mRNA %>%
    group_by(Intron_ID, condition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_IRratio = mean(IRratio, na.rm = T),
              mean_IntronDepth = mean(IntronDepth, na.rm = T),
              mean_maxExon_expression = mean(maxExon_expression, na.rm = T),
              mean_SSratio_L = mean(SSratio_L, na.rm = T),
              mean_SSratio_R = mean(SSratio_R, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop")

SSratio <- 1.2
maxExon_expression <- 10

IRratio_mRNA_sum_f <- IRratio_mRNA_sum %>%
    filter(mean_IRratio <= 1, 
           mean_SSratio_L > SSratio | mean_SSratio_R > SSratio,
           mean_maxExon_expression >= maxExon_expression) %>%
    mutate(experiment = "mRNA")

tmp <- rbind(IRratio_dFORCE_sum_f, IRratio_mRNA_sum_f) 
p <- ggplot(tmp[tmp$experiment=="dFORCE",], 
            aes(x = condition, y = mean_IRratio)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.9)) + 
    labs(x = NULL, title = "dFORCE") 
gt <- fix_panel_size(p, panel_width = 3, panel_height = panel_height)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(gt)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
DMSO_m6A_both <- data.frame(ID = unique(c(DMSO_m6A_dFORCE$ID,
                                          DMSO_m6A_mRNA$ID)))

DMSO_m6A_both$m6A_group <- case_when(
    DMSO_m6A_both$ID %in% intersect(DMSO_m6A_dFORCE$ID, DMSO_m6A_mRNA$ID) ~ "Both",
    DMSO_m6A_both$ID %in% DMSO_m6A_dFORCE$ID ~ "Only dFORCE",
    DMSO_m6A_both$ID %in% DMSO_m6A_mRNA$ID ~ "Only mRNA"
)

DMSO_m6A_both_mRNA <- DMSO_m6A_both %>% mutate(group = "mRNA")
DMSO_m6A_both_dFORCE <- DMSO_m6A_both %>% mutate(group = "dFORCE")

## load and assign mRNA stoi data
path_f <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Miona/Nanopore/PlaB_mRNA_all/filtered_m6A_cov_5/"
all_f <- list.files(path_f)

for (i in 1:length(all_f)) {
    if (i == 1) {
        all_sites <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        all_sites$sample <- sub("HEK293T_mRNA_", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("_filtered_m6A.bed", "", .)
    } else {
        tmp <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        tmp$sample <- sub("HEK293T_mRNA_", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("_filtered_m6A.bed", "", .)
        all_sites <- rbind(all_sites, tmp)
    }
}

all_sites <- all_sites %>% mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB1_")        ~ "STM.PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB10_")       ~ "STM.PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM_PlaB100_")      ~ "STM.PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB100_")          ~ "PlaB.100nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB10_")           ~ "PlaB.10nM",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB1_")            ~ "PlaB.1nM",
      str_detect(sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      str_detect(sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )
)

all_sites$rep <- sub(".*_", "", all_sites$sample)
all_sites$ID <- 
    paste0(all_sites$chr, ":", all_sites$start, " ", all_sites$strand)
all_sites$sample <- paste0(all_sites$condition,"_",all_sites$rep)

all_mRNA_sites <- data.frame(ID = unique(all_sites$ID)) 

test <- unique(all_sites$sample)
for (i in 1:length(test)) {
    tmp <- all_sites[all_sites$sample == test[[i]],]
    all_mRNA_sites[,paste0(test[[i]], "_stoi")] <- tmp$Stoichiometry[match(
        all_mRNA_sites$ID, tmp$ID
    )]
    
}


all_mRNA_sites <- as.data.frame(all_mRNA_sites) %>%
  mutate(
    DMSO_mean_stoi = rowMeans(across(matches("^DMSO_Rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = F)
  ) 


DMSO_m6A_both_mRNA$Stoichiomtry <- all_mRNA_sites$DMSO_mean_stoi[
    match(DMSO_m6A_both_mRNA$ID, all_mRNA_sites$ID)
]

## load and assign dFORCE stoi data
path_f <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Miona/Nanopore/PlaB_dFORCE/m6A/"
all_f <- list.files(path_f)

for (i in 1:length(all_f)) {
    if (i == 1) {
        all_sites <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        all_sites$sample <- sub("_filtered.*", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dFirce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dForce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("dForce_", "", .)
    } else {
        tmp <- read_nanopore_bed(paste0(path_f, all_f[[i]]))
        tmp$sample <- sub("_filtered.*", "", all_f[[i]]) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dFirce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("HEK293T_dForce_", "", .) %>%
            sub("dForce_", "", .)
        all_sites <- rbind(all_sites, tmp)
    }
}

all_sites <- all_sites %>% mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB_STM|STM_PlaB") ~ "PlaB.STM",
      str_detect(sample, "DMSO")              ~ "DMSO",
      str_detect(sample, "PlaB")              ~ "PlaB",
      str_detect(sample, "STM")               ~ "STM",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )
)

all_sites$rep <- sub(".*_", "", all_sites$sample) 
all_sites$rep <- case_when(all_sites$rep %in% c("2h", "1") ~ "rep1",
                      T ~ all_sites$rep)

all_sites$ID <- 
    paste0(all_sites$chr, ":", all_sites$start, " ", all_sites$strand)
all_sites$sample <- paste0(all_sites$condition,"_",all_sites$rep)

all_dFORCE_sites <- data.frame(ID = unique(all_sites$ID)) 

test <- unique(all_sites$sample)
for (i in 1:length(test)) {
    tmp <- all_sites[all_sites$sample == test[[i]],]
    all_dFORCE_sites[,paste0(test[[i]], "_stoi")] <- tmp$Stoichiometry[match(
        all_dFORCE_sites$ID, tmp$ID
    )]
    
}


all_dFORCE_sites <- as.data.frame(all_dFORCE_sites) %>%
  mutate(
    DMSO_mean_stoi = if_else(
      rowSums(!is.na(pick(matches("^DMSO_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")))) >= 2,
      rowMeans(pick(matches("^DMSO_rep[0-9]+_stoi$")), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    )
  )


DMSO_m6A_both_dFORCE$Stoichiomtry <- all_dFORCE_sites$DMSO_mean_stoi[
    match(DMSO_m6A_both_mRNA$ID, all_dFORCE_sites$ID)
]
DMSO_m6A_both <- rbind(DMSO_m6A_both_dFORCE, DMSO_m6A_both_mRNA)

saveRDS(DMSO_m6A_both, "rds/DMSO_m6A_both.rds")
```

```{r}
make_ir_gr <- function(ir){
    ir$chr <- sub(":.*", "",ir$Intron_ID) %>% as.factor(.)
    ir$start <- getstr(ir$Intron_ID, ":", 1, "-", 1) %>% as.numeric(.)
    ir$end <- getstr(ir$Intron_ID, "-", 1, "_", 1) %>% as.numeric(.)
```

Code for splitting reads based on spliced status:

```ruby
## code for split unspliced and spliced reads
source ~/.bashrc

set -euo pipefail
shopt -s nullglob

threads=16
outdir="split_splicing"

mkdir -p "$outdir"

# Exclude:
# 0x4   = unmapped
flag_filter=4

summary="$outdir/read_splicing_summary.tsv"

echo -e "sample\tprimary_mapped\tspliced\tunspliced" > "$summary"

for bam in *.bam; do

    sample=$(basename "$bam" .bam)

    echo "Processing $sample"

    # Total number of primary mapped reads
    total=$(samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -c \
        -F "$flag_filter" \
        "$bam")

    # -----------------------
    # Spliced reads
    # CIGAR contains N
    # -----------------------
    samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -h \
        -F "$flag_filter" \
        "$bam" \
    | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} /^@/ || $6 ~ /N/' \
    | samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -b \
        -o "$outdir/${sample}.spliced.bam" \
        -

    # -----------------------
    # Unspliced reads
    # CIGAR does not contain N
    # -----------------------
    samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -h \
        -F "$flag_filter" \
        "$bam" \
    | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} /^@/ || $6 !~ /N/' \
    | samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -b \
        -o "$outdir/${sample}.unspliced.bam" \
        -

    # Index
    samtools index \
        -@ "$threads" \
        "$outdir/${sample}.spliced.bam"

    samtools index \
        -@ "$threads" \
        "$outdir/${sample}.unspliced.bam"

    # Count
    spliced=$(samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -c \
        "$outdir/${sample}.spliced.bam")

    unspliced=$(samtools view \
        -@ "$threads" \
        -c \
        "$outdir/${sample}.unspliced.bam")

    echo -e "${sample}\t${total}\t${spliced}\t${unspliced}" \
        >> "$summary"

    # Sanity check
    if (( spliced + unspliced != total )); then
        echo "WARNING: counts do not add up for $sample" >&2
    fi

    echo "$sample:"
    echo "  primary mapped = $total"
    echo "  spliced        = $spliced"
    echo "  unspliced      = $unspliced"

done

echo "Read splitting completed"
```

Code for extract unspliced reads which overlap to intron boundary.

```ruby
## extract unspliced raeds which overlap to intron
source ~/.bashrc    

for bam in *.unspliced.bam; do
    bedtools intersect \
        -abam $bam \
        -b ~/anno/hg38_v45/hg38_v45_intron.bed \
        -u \
        | samtools view -b -o ${bam%.unspliced.bam}_intron_overlapping.bam -

    samtools index ${bam%.unspliced.bam}_intron_overlapping.bam
done
```

The code above retains reads containing an 'N' in their CIGAR strings, as well as reads without an 
'N' that overlap intronic regions, for downstream analysis.

## Basic status 

```{r}
## read data mRNA
path_f <- "~/Desktop/Data/Julian_lab/Miona/Nanopore/PlaB_mRNA_all/read_split/"
files_bed <- list.files(
    path_f,
    pattern = "\\.bed$",
    full.names = TRUE
)

# Exclude STM samples
files_bed <- files_bed[!grepl("STM", basename(files_bed))]

# Extract sample type
get_sample_type <- function(filename) {
    filename <- basename(filename)

    case_when(
        str_detect(filename, "DMSO") ~ "DMSO",
        str_detect(filename, "PlaB_?100") ~ "PlaB_100nM",
        str_detect(filename, "PlaB_?10") ~ "PlaB_10nM",
        str_detect(filename, "PlaB_?1") ~ "PlaB_1nM",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
}

# Extract replicate information
get_replicate <- function(filename) {
    filename <- basename(filename)

    case_when(
        str_detect(filename, regex("repeat_vol2", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "rep1",
        str_detect(filename, regex("rep2", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "rep2",
        str_detect(filename, regex("rep1", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "rep1",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
}

# Read BED files and add metadata
bed_data_mRNA <- map_dfr(files_bed, function(file) {

    tmp <- read_nanopore_bed(file)
    
    as.data.frame(tmp) %>%
        mutate(
            sample_type = get_sample_type(file),
            replicate = get_replicate(file),

            splice_type = if_else(
                str_detect(basename(file), "\\.spliced_"),
                "spliced",
                "unspliced"
            ),

            sample_id = str_remove(
                basename(file),
                "\\.sorted\\..*$"
            )
        )
})

## uniuqe id
bed_data_mRNA$unique_id <- paste0(bed_data_mRNA$ID, "_", bed_data_mRNA$sample_type, "_", bed_data_mRNA$splice_type)
keep <- table(bed_data_mRNA$unique_id[bed_data_mRNA$Stoichiometry > 20])
keep <- names(keep)[keep == 2]

## keep only 
bed_data_mRNA_f <- bed_data_mRNA[bed_data_mRNA$unique_id %in% keep,]

mRNA_m6A <- bed_data_mRNA_f %>%
    group_by(chr, start, end, strand, ID, sample_type, splice_type) %>%
    summarise(Stoi_mean = mean(Stoichiometry),
              cov_mean = mean(N_valid_cov), .groups = "drop")
## kep main chr sites
mRNA_m6A <- mRNA_m6A[grep("chr", mRNA_m6A$chr),]
```

## Stoichiometry correlation spliced vs unspliced dFORCE

```{r}
DMSO_s <- dFORCE_m6A[dFORCE_m6A$sample_type == "DMSO" &
                         dFORCE_m6A$splice_type == "spliced",]
DMSO_uns_all <- bed_data_dFORCE[bed_data_dFORCE$sample_type == "DMSO" &
                         bed_data_dFORCE$splice_type == "unspliced",]

PlaB_s <- dFORCE_m6A[dFORCE_m6A$sample_type == "PlaB" &
                         dFORCE_m6A$splice_type == "spliced",]
PlaB_uns_all <- bed_data_dFORCE[bed_data_dFORCE$sample_type == "PlaB" &
                         bed_data_dFORCE$splice_type == "unspliced",]

## mean stoi
DMSO_uns_all <- DMSO_uns_all %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise(Stoi_mean = mean(Stoichiometry, na.rm = T))
PlaB_uns_all <- PlaB_uns_all %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    summarise(Stoi_mean = mean(Stoichiometry, na.rm = T))

DMSO_s$stoi_uns <- DMSO_uns_all$Stoi_mean[match(DMSO_s$ID,
                                            DMSO_uns_all$ID)]
PlaB_s$stoi_uns <- PlaB_uns_all$Stoi_mean[match(PlaB_s$ID,
                                            PlaB_uns_all$ID)]
```

:::panel-tabset

## DMSO

```{r}
ggplot(DMSO_s, aes(x = Stoi_mean, y = stoi_uns)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_abline(linetype = 2) + 
    labs(y = "Stoichiometry with unspliced reads",
         x = "Stoichiometry with spliced reads")
```

```{r}
         x = "Stoichiometry with spliced reads")
```

## Stoichiometry comparison mRNA vs dFORCE

```{r}
DMSO_s_mRNA <- mRNA_m6A[mRNA_m6A$sample_type == "DMSO" &
                            mRNA_m6A$splice_type == "spliced",]

DMSO_s_mRNA$stoi_dFORCE <- DMSO_s$Stoi_mean[match(
    DMSO_s_mRNA$ID, DMSO_s$ID
)]

ggplot(as.data.frame(DMSO_s_mRNA), aes(x = Stoi_mean, y = stoi_dFORCE)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    geom_abline(linetype = 2) +
    labs(y = "Stoi in dFORCE spliced reads",
         x = "Stoi in mRNA spliced reads") + 
    stat_cor()
```


## EJC pattern for spliced and unspliced reads in dFORCE

```{r}
dFORCE_m6A <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(dFORCE_m6A, keep.extra.columns = T)
dFORCE_m6A <- dis_to_SS_v2(dFORCE_m6A, anno = hg38)

dFORCE_m6A$bin_dis_SS <- cut(dFORCE_m6A$dis_SS,
                             breaks = c(0,50,100,200,Inf))

ggplot(as.data.frame(dFORCE_m6A[!is.na(dFORCE_m6A$bin_dis_SS)]),
       aes(x = bin_dis_SS, y = Stoi_mean, fill = splice_type)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
    facet_wrap(~sample_type)
```
